summary: Appends a new 56-byte node to a singly-linked list whose next pointers live at node+0x34. Reads the head from this+0xF0; when the head exists, walks the chain following node+0x34 to the tail, otherwise treats this+0xF0 as empty. Allocates 56 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes each node via StructZeroInitWithBaseCall, and links it in (tail+0x34 = new node, or this+0xF0 = new node for the first). Returns the new node pointer, or 0 on allocation failure.

operations.description: Read the list head pointer from this+0xF0 (dword index 60).
Branch on whether the head is non-null: walk the existing chain or allocate the first node.
Traverse the singly-linked list, following the next pointer at node+0x34 until the tail (node whose next is 0).
Branch on whether the 56-byte allocation returned non-null.
StructZeroInitWithBaseCall(newNode) zero-initializes the allocated node via its base constructor call.
Link the previous tail's next pointer at +0x34 to the new node.
On allocation failure, set result to 0 and clear the tail's next pointer at +0x34 to 0.
When the head was empty, OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(56) allocates the first node block.
StructZeroInitWithBaseCall(firstNode) zero-initializes the first allocated node.
Set the head pointer this+0xF0 to the newly created first node.
On first-allocation failure, set result to 0 and clear the head this+0xF0 to 0.
Return the new node pointer, or 0 when either allocation failed.
